name: solinal-gestiona
description: Monorepo root: orchestrates frontend/ (Vite+React, deploy to Vercel) and backend/ (Express+Prisma, deploy to Render). Each has its own package.json/lockfile and deploys independently — these scripts are local dev/build convenience only.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,blue "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
